model_type: ensemble: SVR (kernel=rbf, C=10.0, epsilon=0.1, gamma=scale) + RandomForestRegressor (n_estimators=300, max_depth=None, min_samples_leaf=2, random_state=42), unweighted mean of the two predictions

physchem_notes.amphipathicity: custom, not native modlAMP: hydrophobic_moment / mean(abs(eisenberg per-residue H))
physchem_notes.d_residue_fraction: fraction of lowercase residues in raw sequence (D-amino acid marker), sequences folded to uppercase for all other descriptors

esm_embedding: mean-pooled last_hidden_state, excludes BOS token and final valid (EOS) token, sequence uppercased before tokenization
species_ohe_handle_unknown: ignore (out-of-vocabulary species map to an all-zero one-hot vector, not an error)
preprocessing_order: 1. compute 14 modlAMP physchem descriptors on the raw sequence
3. compute ESM2-150M mean-pooled embedding (640-dim) on the uppercased sequence
5. esm2_pca.transform (PCA fit on scaled training embeddings, n_components=0.95 -> 27 PCs)
7. concatenate [species_onehot, physchem_scaled, esm2_pcs] -> 54-dim vector -> SVR.predict and RandomForestRegressor.predict, averaged
train_test_split_for_cv_reference: 115 train / 32 test, stratified by species with a floor of 1 per split (final models are refit on all 147 rows)
cv_protocol: 10-fold KFold(shuffle=True, random_state=42) over the full 147-row dataset; species_ohe, both StandardScalers, and PCA refit inside each fold on that fold's training rows only
model_selection_note: RF and SVR are statistically indistinguishable under 10-fold CV. Both are deployed as an unweighted-mean ensemble to combine their independent error profiles, rather than picking one.
final_fit: both physchem/esm2 preprocessing, the SVR, and the RandomForestRegressor are refit on all 147 rows (not just the 115-row train split) before saving
